Please make use of these tools. Phone: 208 391 3814 Email: edelweissclubboise@gmail.com You can also find us on facebook. If you have an upcoming “Milestone” Birthday, please let the Board know a month ahead. Thanks. If I missed someone I apologize, please e-mail your Birthday information to Nancy or call Emma. Thanks June Birthdays 3rd Bernadette Cornell 9th Karl-Heinz Ruttke 13th Petra Morrison 18th Helga Fealko 22nd Dr. Doris Eggert 26th Jetta Schmidt 26th William Roberts 27th Brigitte Barr 28th Olinda Ackermann 29th Uschi Krausse Welcome new Board Directors and Congratulations! Jakob is our Vice-President and Greg K is our Board Member. Dagmar and Nancy will be missed. There may be some changes made in the line-up. We will check the bi-laws of the Club and let you know how and if we can proceed with a slight change of the Board.

Christkindle Market TBD Christmas Party 25th Weihnacht Future Happenings Mai activities Friday, 1st of Mai, we will meet at 1pm at the entrance of the Zoo. Admission is $12. Kids under 12 and adults over the age of 62 will only pay $9. You can bring your walker and /or wheel- chair. Please let Dagmar Nieland know if you are interested. Mai fest on Saturday, May 16th at Kleiner Park, station A4. Brats and Schnitzel. We have invited Don and Sharon to play for us. Members bring a side dish or dessert to share. Please bring your own drinks. We will start at 4pm. Eat around 4:30pm June We would like to try out “Black Market Gelateria”. A European- style café known for its authentic, handcrafted gelato, sorbet and coffee. Pastries available. 2545 S Fry St. #110. Boise. Date is not established yet. Look for sign-up sheet at the Maifest. Cultural Dinner 2026 This will take place on Friday, July 17th at the Paramount Clubhouse. It was decided that the cost was too great to have it catered. We have 2 volunteers from the Board to make Rouladen and /or Sauerbraten with sides. Members may bring a salad or dessert. If you prefer porcelain dishes, please bring them with you. More in the July Newsletter. RSVP please. Sign-up sheet at Maifest. AUGUST 2026 Any interest in a trip to Jack pot? Any other ideas? Sept/October We will attend the Nampa Oktoberfest as a Club. Nov/Dec Would anyone be interested in attending the Christkindle Market in Seattle, WA? Cheap flights can hopefully be found again. Mountain Home Christkindle Market? We had some people in the Hospital in the last 2 month. Sounds like everyone is home and recovering. Wishing you further healing and a speedy recovery. Safe travels to everyone on your adventures! Stay alert and hope to see many of you at one of our get-to-gathers. Happy MOTHER’S DAY to all women! Happy FATHER’S DAY to all men!
